body.summary: In runPlanner, when the first failure is not INV-13, run the count check on the same stamped plan and pass a non-null result to appendCorrectionTurn. failures[], the feedback files and the thrown error keep the primary failure only. Add the recording-stub-provider tests and, separately, the structuredStageForTest history and persistence tests from the LLD.

the INV-1 case states the count as well and keeps INV-1 primary
